name: 50613-mixedprefix-16b-1gpu
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat, bf16. deepseek license, ungated, 15.7e9 parameters, ~31.4 GB of weights.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process engine, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM -- a 27-layer multi-head-latent-attention mixture-of-experts decoder; shapes are in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 3200 requests (100 rounds of 32) with an 1800 s safety cap, seed static 50613.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn: 513 unique prompt tokens plus a shared cached prefix per request, exactly one output token, temperature 0. Two prefix buckets, 60,000 tokens at weight 3 and 64 tokens at weight 97, so about 1 request in 32 is long-prefix; total cached context 60,000 + 31 x 64 = 61,984 tokens. Prefix caching on, `request_format: plain` so no chat template shifts the shared span.
purpose: A 16-billion-parameter chat assistant on one GPU, serving 32 concurrent single-turn requests that share short or very long prefixes.
launch:
# Engine arguments for commit e7b8d5946095a594af2cf7ca3c314b9806cb7c32; `configs/env.yaml` says
# where that engine lives on this machine. Everything not listed here is left at the default.
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat

# Clears the long bucket: a 60,000-token prefix + 513-token body + 1 output token.
max-model-len: 65536

# The workload is prefill on already-cached context; with the cache off it does not exist.
enable-prefix-caching: true

max-num-seqs: 32

# Must CLEAR the 32 x 513 = 16,416 uncached tokens the in-flight set carries in one step. 16384
# is short by exactly 32 tokens and would split the last request across two steps.
max-num-batched-tokens: 32768

# The engine's CUDA default, written out because prefix-cache hits are whole blocks.
block-size: 16

tensor-parallel-size: 1
